mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, balance, total_earned AS totalEarned, settled_traffic AS settledTraffic, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xray_user_point (user_id, balance, total_earned, settled_traffic, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{balance}, #{totalEarned}, #{settledTraffic}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE xray_user_point SET balance = balance + #{earned}, total_earned = total_earned + #{earned}, settled_traffic = #{newSettledTraffic}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND settled_traffic = #{expectSettledTraffic}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xray_point_record (user_id, change_amount, balance_after, type, remark, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{type}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, change_amount AS changeAmount, balance_after AS balanceAfter, type, remark, created_at AS createdAt FROM xray_point_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT u.id FROM xray_user u LEFT JOIN xray_user_point p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE COALESCE(u.used_traffic, 0) > COALESCE(p.settled_traffic, 0) ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{limit}
